records.name: Phantom Fist
records.character_source: Mira / Hit / Yamcha (Supervillain) / Masked Saiyan / Frost / Fu customizable partner / Future Warrior
records.skill_description: A defensive movement Super that creates an afterimage-like stance; when an attack connects, the user vanishes and reappears while recovering stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: Phantom Fist functions as an afterimage-style defensive evasion: an incoming attack can cause the user to vanish and reappear while recovering stamina. The current dedicated Xenoverse 2 reference describes roughly 100 stamina recovery. Historical Xenoverse 2 player reports document activation-delay and repeated-use behavior, so exact frame windows and repeat timing remain version-sensitive and are not encoded as canonical numeric values.
records.acquisition_notes: The documented Xenoverse 2 Future Warrior route is Parallel Quest 97 — Insidious Plot. Current PQ reward references place Phantom Fist in Basic Rewards; no Ultimate Finish-only condition or drop probability is inferred. It is also used by Mira, Hit, Masked Saiyan and Yamcha (Supervillain), with Frost and later Partner Customization context documented separately.
records.pve_notes: PQ97 acquisition; exact drop probability and Ultimate Finish dependency remain unresolved.
records.pvp_notes: Defensive evasion/counter-style behavior can avoid incoming attacks and restore stamina. Historical player reports document balance changes, so exact timing and repeated activation behavior should be treated as version-sensitive.
